How to use#

Copy into the project, wrap the page in class="g" and optionally set data-direction to one of the twelve presets. Class reference and markup: starter kit; recipes: style directions.

Source#

/*
 * Design Skill starter kit · the visual craft baseline as plain CSS.
 * Use: add class "g" to the page wrapper and optionally data-direction="…"
 * (see references/starter-kit.md). Load the fonts your direction names.
 * Licence: MIT, as part of Design Skill.
 */
.g {
  --g-bg: #fff;
  --g-fg: #0a0a0a;
  --g-muted: #5f6368;
  --g-raised: #f6f6f5;
  --g-card: #fff;
  --g-line: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  --g-border: 1px;
  --g-accent: #0a0a0a;
  --g-on-accent: #fff;
  --g-font: "Inter Variable", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --g-display: var(--g-font);
  --g-display-weight: 500;
  --g-display-tracking: -0.045em;
  --g-display-case: none;
  --g-mono: "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
  --g-btn-radius: 10px;
  --g-radius: 20px;
  --g-radius-lg: 24px;
  --g-btn-shadow: none;
  --g-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04), 0 16px 40px -16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
  background: var(--g-bg);
  color: var(--g-fg);
  font: 400 16px/1.6 var(--g-font);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  overflow-x: clip;
}
.g h1,
.g h2,
.g h3 {
  font-family: var(--g-display);
  font-weight: var(--g-display-weight);
  text-transform: var(--g-display-case);
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.g p {
  margin: 0;
}
.g-wrap {
  width: min(1200px, 100% - 48px);
  margin-inline: auto;
}

/* Header */
.g-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 40;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-bg) 80%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(14px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g-line);
}
.g-header .g-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: 64px;
  gap: 32px;
}
.g-logo {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 15px;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.g-nav {
  display: flex;
  gap: 28px;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.g-nav a,
.g-header-links a:not(.g-btn) {
  color: var(--g-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 150ms;
}
.g-nav a:hover,
.g-header-links a:not(.g-btn):hover {
  color: var(--g-fg);
}
.g-header-links {
  margin-left: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  font-size: 14px;
}

/* Controls */
.g-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 40px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--g-btn-radius);
  font: 500 14px/1 var(--g-font);
  letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background-color 150ms,
    border-color 150ms,
    transform 120ms;
}
.g-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.98);
}
.g-btn-primary {
  background: var(--g-accent);
  color: var(--g-on-accent);
  box-shadow: var(--g-btn-shadow);
}
.g-btn-primary:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-accent) 86%, var(--g-bg));
}
.g-btn-secondary {
  background: var(--g-card);
  border-color: var(--g-line);
  color: var(--g-fg);
}
.g-btn-secondary:hover {
  background: var(--g-raised);
}
.g-btn-lg {
  height: 44px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  font-size: 15px;
}
.g-btn-sm {
  height: 34px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.g-input {
  height: 44px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border: var(--g-border) solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: var(--g-btn-radius);
  background: var(--g-card);
  color: var(--g-fg);
  font: 400 15px var(--g-font);
}
.g a:focus-visible,
.g button:focus-visible,
.g input:focus-visible,
.g summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--g-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Hero */
.g-hero {
  padding: 120px 0 0;
  text-align: center;
}
.g-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 30px;
  padding: 0 12px 0 4px;
  border: var(--g-border) solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--g-card);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--g-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.g-pill b {
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--g-raised);
  color: var(--g-fg);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.g-display {
  margin: 24px auto 20px;
  max-width: 820px;
  font-size: clamp(42px, 5.4vw, 70px);
  line-height: 1.04;
  letter-spacing: var(--g-display-tracking);
}
.g .g-lede {
  max-width: 560px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--g-muted);
}
.g-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 32px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.g .g-proof {
  margin-top: 16px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--g-muted);
}

/* Media frame */
.g-frame {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--g-radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}
.g-frame-art {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
}
.g-window {
  border: var(--g-border) solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--g-card);
  box-shadow: var(--g-shadow);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: left;
}
.g-window-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 36px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  background: var(--g-raised);
}
.g-window-bar i {
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 18%, transparent);
}

/* Sections */
.g-section {
  padding: 120px 0;
}
.g-section + .g-section {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--g-line);
}
.g-head {
  max-width: 600px;
  margin: 0 auto 56px;
  text-align: center;
}
.g-eyebrow {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--g-muted);
}
.g-h2 {
  margin: 12px 0 14px;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 44px);
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}
.g-head p {
  color: var(--g-muted);
  font-size: 17px;
}

/* Bento */
.g-bento {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
}
.g-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border: var(--g-border) solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: var(--g-radius);
  background: var(--g-card);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.g-card-visual {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 220px;
  padding: 24px;
  background: var(--g-raised);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.g-card-body {
  padding: 24px 28px 28px;
}
.g-card h3 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
}
.g-card p {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--g-muted);
}
.g-span-7 {
  grid-column: span 7;
}
.g-span-5 {
  grid-column: span 5;
}
.g-span-6 {
  grid-column: span 6;
}
.g-span-4 {
  grid-column: span 4;
}

/* Steps */
.g-steps {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.g-steps li {
  padding: 28px;
  border: var(--g-border) solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: var(--g-radius);
  background: var(--g-card);
}
.g-steps span {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--g-raised);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.g-steps h3 {
  margin: 20px 0 6px;
  font-size: 18px;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
}
.g-steps p {
  color: var(--g-muted);
  font-size: 15px;
}

/* Pricing */
.g-pricing {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: stretch;
}
.g-plan {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 28px;
  border: var(--g-border) solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: var(--g-radius);
  background: var(--g-card);
}
.g-plan.is-featured {
  border-color: var(--g-fg);
  box-shadow: var(--g-shadow);
}
.g-plan h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
.g-plan > p {
  color: var(--g-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.g-price {
  margin: 24px 0;
  font-size: 40px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  line-height: 1;
}
.g-price small {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--g-muted);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
.g-plan ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 24px 0 0;
  padding: 24px 0 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.g-plan li {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: start;
}
.g-plan li svg {
  margin-top: 3px;
  color: var(--g-muted);
}

/* FAQ */
.g-faq {
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--g-line);
}
.g-faq details {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g-line);
}
.g-faq summary {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 20px 0;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
}
.g-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.g-faq summary::after {
  content: "+";
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--g-muted);
  transition: transform 150ms;
}
.g-faq details[open] summary::after {
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
.g-faq details p {
  padding: 0 0 20px;
  color: var(--g-muted);
  max-width: 62ch;
}

/* Final CTA */
.g-cta {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 96px 32px;
  border-radius: var(--g-radius-lg);
  text-align: center;
}
.g-cta .g-h2 {
  margin-top: 0;
}

/* Footer */
.g-footer {
  padding: 64px 0 40px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  font-size: 14px;
}
.g-footer-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 32px;
}
.g-footer p,
.g-footer a {
  color: var(--g-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.g-footer a:hover {
  color: var(--g-fg);
}
.g-footer h4 {
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.g-footer ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}
.g-footer-legal {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-top: 56px;
  padding-top: 24px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--g-muted);
}

/* Entrance */
@keyframes g-rise {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(12px);
  }
}
.g-rise {
  animation: g-rise 700ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both;
}
.g-rise-2 {
  animation-delay: 80ms;
}
.g-rise-3 {
  animation-delay: 160ms;
}
.g-rise-4 {
  animation-delay: 240ms;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .g-rise {
    animation: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .g-nav {
    display: none;
  }
  .g-span-7,
  .g-span-5,
  .g-span-6,
  .g-span-4 {
    grid-column: span 12;
  }
  .g-steps,
  .g-pricing {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .g-footer-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .g-wrap {
    width: calc(100% - 40px);
  }
  .g-header-links .g-hide-sm {
    display: none;
  }
  .g-hero {
    padding-top: 72px;
  }
  .g-display {
    font-size: 40px;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  }
  .g-lede {
    font-size: 16px;
  }
  .g-section {
    padding: 80px 0;
  }
  .g-h2 {
    font-size: 30px;
  }
  .g-head {
    margin-bottom: 40px;
  }
  .g-cta {
    padding: 64px 20px;
  }
  .g-footer-legal {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }
}

/* Extra sections */
.g-logos {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px 48px;
  opacity: 0.55;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.g-metrics {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
  text-align: center;
}
.g-metrics strong {
  display: block;
  font: var(--g-display-weight) clamp(36px, 4vw, 52px) / 1 var(--g-display);
  letter-spacing: var(--g-display-tracking);
}
.g-metrics span {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--g-muted);
}
.g-quote {
  padding: 28px;
  border: var(--g-border) solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: var(--g-radius);
  background: var(--g-card);
}
.g-quote blockquote {
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.g-quote figcaption {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--g-muted);
}
.g-split {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
  gap: 64px;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: left;
}
.g-split .g-display,
.g-split .g-lede {
  margin-left: 0;
}
.g-split .g-actions {
  justify-content: start;
}
.g-fullbleed {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  display: grid;
  align-items: end;
  min-height: min(92vh, 900px);
  padding: 120px 0 64px;
  color: #fff;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.g-fullbleed > img,
.g-fullbleed > video,
.g-fullbleed > .g-frame-art {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -2;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.g-fullbleed::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%);
}
.g-marquee {
  display: flex;
  gap: 48px;
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font: var(--g-display-weight) clamp(40px, 7vw, 96px) / 1 var(--g-display);
  text-transform: var(--g-display-case);
  letter-spacing: var(--g-display-tracking);
}
.g-marquee > span {
  animation: g-marquee 30s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes g-marquee {
  to {
    transform: translateX(-100%);
  }
}
.g-phone {
  width: 300px;
  height: 640px;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 52px;
  background: #111;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 1.5px #3f3f46,
    0 40px 80px -24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}
.g-phone > * {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 42px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--g-card);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .g-marquee > span {
    animation: none;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .g-split {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 40px;
  }
  .g-metrics {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
}

/* Direction presets: tokens only. Pair with the fonts named in style-directions.md. */
.g[data-direction="dark-technical"] {
  --g-bg: #000;
  --g-fg: #fafafa;
  --g-muted: #a1a1aa;
  --g-raised: #0e0e10;
  --g-card: #09090b;
  --g-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
  --g-accent: #fafafa;
  --g-on-accent: #000;
  --g-font: "Geist Variable", "Geist", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --g-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04), 0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
}
.g[data-direction="luminous"] {
  --g-bg: #fbfbfe;
  --g-raised: #f2f1fb;
  --g-accent: #18181b;
  --g-btn-radius: 999px;
  --g-radius: 28px;
  --g-radius-lg: 32px;
  --g-font: "Inter Variable", "Sora", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.g[data-direction="editorial"] {
  --g-bg: #f7f5f0;
  --g-raised: #efece4;
  --g-card: #f7f5f0;
  --g-fg: #161513;
  --g-muted: #5c5850;
  --g-line: rgba(22, 21, 19, 0.14);
  --g-accent: #161513;
  --g-display: "Instrument Serif", "Newsreader", Georgia, serif;
  --g-display-weight: 400;
  --g-display-tracking: -0.02em;
  --g-btn-radius: 0;
  --g-radius: 4px;
  --g-radius-lg: 4px;
  --g-shadow: none;
}
.g[data-direction="warm-organic"] {
  --g-bg: #f4ede2;
  --g-raised: #ebe1d1;
  --g-card: #fbf7f0;
  --g-fg: #2b1e17;
  --g-muted: #6a5447;
  --g-line: rgba(43, 30, 23, 0.12);
  --g-accent: #a9482a;
  --g-display: "Fraunces Variable", "Young Serif", Georgia, serif;
  --g-display-weight: 420;
  --g-display-tracking: -0.025em;
  --g-font: "Figtree Variable", "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --g-btn-radius: 999px;
  --g-radius: 24px;
  --g-radius-lg: 28px;
}
.g[data-direction="luxury"] {
  --g-bg: #f8f6f1;
  --g-raised: #efebe3;
  --g-card: #f8f6f1;
  --g-fg: #111;
  --g-muted: #6b665d;
  --g-line: rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.14);
  --g-accent: #111;
  --g-display: "Cormorant Garamond", "Bodoni Moda", Georgia, serif;
  --g-display-weight: 400;
  --g-display-tracking: -0.01em;
  --g-btn-radius: 0;
  --g-radius: 0;
  --g-radius-lg: 0;
  --g-shadow: none;
}
.g[data-direction="bold"] {
  --g-bg: #0b0b0b;
  --g-fg: #fff;
  --g-muted: #bdbdbd;
  --g-raised: #161616;
  --g-card: #121212;
  --g-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  --g-accent: #ff4f2b;
  --g-on-accent: #fff;
  --g-display: "Anton", "Bebas Neue", "Archivo", Impact, sans-serif;
  --g-display-weight: 400;

title: product.css
description: Product kit: app shell, forms, tables, badges, alerts, tabs, dialogs, toasts, density modes and dark tokens.
html:
How to use#

Load after starter.css for apps, dashboards, admin and settings screens. It reuses the same --g-* tokens, so direction presets still apply, and adds status tokens, density modes and dark tokens. Class reference and markup: starter kit; guidance: product UI.

Source#

/*
 * Design Skill product kit · app shell, forms, tables and feedback as plain CSS.
 * Load after starter.css; it reuses the same --g-* tokens, so direction presets apply.
 * Use: <div class="g g-app" data-density="default|compact|comfortable">.
 * Dark mode: add data-theme="dark" to .g or an ancestor.
 * See references/starter-kit.md and references/product-ui.md. Licence: MIT, as part of Design Skill.
 */
.g {
  --g-success: #067647;
  --g-success-subtle: #ecfdf3;
  --g-warning: #93370d;
  --g-warning-subtle: #fffaeb;
  --g-danger: #b42318;
  --g-danger-subtle: #fef3f2;
  --g-info: #175cd3;
  --g-info-subtle: #eff8ff;
  --g-control: 36px;
  --g-row: 44px;
  --g-pad: 16px;
  --g-text: 14px;
}
.g[data-density="compact"] {
  --g-control: 30px;
  --g-row: 34px;
  --g-pad: 12px;
  --g-text: 13px;
}
.g[data-density="comfortable"] {
  --g-control: 40px;
  --g-row: 52px;
  --g-pad: 24px;
  --g-text: 15px;
}
[data-theme="dark"] .g:not([data-direction]),
.g[data-theme="dark"]:not([data-direction]) {
  --g-bg: #0a0a0a;
  --g-fg: #fafafa;
  --g-muted: #a1a1aa;
  --g-raised: #141416;
  --g-card: #111113;
  --g-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
  --g-accent: #fafafa;
  --g-on-accent: #0a0a0a;
  --g-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), 0 20px 50px -20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
  color-scheme: dark;
}
[data-theme="dark"] .g,
.g[data-theme="dark"] {
  --g-success: #75e0a7;
  --g-success-subtle: #0b2a1c;
  --g-warning: #fec84b;
  --g-warning-subtle: #2b1d06;
  --g-danger: #fda29b;
  --g-danger-subtle: #2e1110;
  --g-info: #84caff;
  --g-info-subtle: #0b2140;
}

/* App shell */
.g-app {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 256px minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: 56px minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-areas: "side top" "side main";
  height: 100dvh;
  font-size: var(--g-text);
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.g-sidebar {
  grid-area: side;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 12px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  background: var(--g-raised);
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.g-sidebar-label {
  margin: 16px 8px 4px;
  color: var(--g-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.g-nav-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: var(--g-control);
  padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--g-muted);
  font-weight: 500;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.g-nav-item:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 5%, transparent);
  color: var(--g-fg);
}
.g-nav-item[aria-current="page"] {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 8%, transparent);
  color: var(--g-fg);
}
.g-nav-item svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  flex: none;
}
.g-topbar {
  grid-area: top;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  background: var(--g-bg);
}
.g-topbar-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.g-topbar-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.g-main {
  grid-area: main;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: calc(var(--g-pad) * 1.5);
}
.g-page-head {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: var(--g-pad);
}
.g-page-head h1 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
}
.g-page-head p {
  color: var(--g-muted);
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .g-app {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-areas: "top" "main";
  }
  .g-sidebar {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0 auto 0 0;
    z-index: 1300;
    width: min(300px, 86vw);
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    transition:
      transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1),
      visibility 0s 200ms;
  }
  .g-sidebar[data-open="true"] {
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: var(--g-shadow);
    transition-delay: 0s;
  }
  .g-main {
    padding: var(--g-pad);
  }
}

/* Panels and KPIs */
.g-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--g-card);
}
.g-panel-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px var(--g-pad);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.g-panel-body {
  padding: var(--g-pad);
}
.g-kpis {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  /* Keep KPIs to one compact row so the primary list stays above the fold. */
  .g-kpis {
    grid-template-columns: none;
    grid-auto-flow: column;
    grid-auto-columns: minmax(148px, 1fr);
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }
  .g-kpi {
    padding: 12px;
  }
  .g-kpi-value {
    font-size: 22px;
  }
}
.g-kpi {
  padding: var(--g-pad);
  border: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--g-card);
}
.g-kpi-label {
  color: var(--g-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
}
.g-kpi-value {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.g-delta {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.g-delta[data-trend="good"] {
  color: var(--g-success);
}
.g-delta[data-trend="bad"] {
  color: var(--g-danger);
}

/* Forms */
.g-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
}
.g-label {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.g-hint {
  color: var(--g-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
}
.g-error {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--g-danger);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.g-app .g-input,
.g-select,
.g-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  height: var(--g-control);
  padding: 0 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--g-card);
  color: var(--g-fg);
  font: 400 var(--g-text) var(--g-font);
}
.g-textarea {
  min-height: 96px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  resize: vertical;
}
.g-input:hover,
.g-select:hover,
.g-textarea:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 24%, transparent);
}
.g-input[aria-invalid="true"],
.g-select[aria-invalid="true"],
.g-textarea[aria-invalid="true"] {
  border-color: var(--g-danger);
}
.g-app .g-btn {
  height: var(--g-control);
  padding: 0 12px;
  font-size: var(--g-text);
}
.g-btn-danger {
  background: var(--g-danger);
  color: var(--g-bg);
}
.g-btn-ghost {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--g-fg);
}
.g-btn-ghost:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 6%, transparent);
}
.g-btn-ghost[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 10%, transparent);
}
.g-btn[aria-busy="true"] {
  cursor: progress;
  opacity: 0.8;
}
.g-btn:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.5;
}
.g-switch {
  appearance: none;
  position: relative;
  width: 36px;
  height: 20px;
  margin: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 22%, transparent);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 150ms;
}
.g-switch::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px;
  left: 2px;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--g-bg);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}
.g-switch:checked {
  background: var(--g-accent);
}
.g-switch:checked::after {
  transform: translateX(16px);
}
.g .g-switch:focus-visible,
.g .g-tab:focus-visible,
.g .g-select:focus-visible,
.g .g-textarea:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--g-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Tables */
.g-table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--g-card);
}
.g-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: var(--g-text);
}
.g-table th {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  height: var(--g-control);
  padding: 0 var(--g-pad);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  background: var(--g-raised);
  color: var(--g-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.g-table td {
  height: var(--g-row);
  padding: 0 var(--g-pad);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g-line);
}
.g-table tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.g-table tbody tr:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 3%, transparent);
}
.g-table tr[aria-selected="true"] {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-accent) 8%, transparent);
}
.g-table .g-num {
  text-align: right;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* Mobile: opt-in stacked rows. Add data-stack to .g-table and data-label to cells.
   First cell is the row title, second sits beside it (status), the rest flow in two columns. */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .g-table[data-stack] thead {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  }
  .g-table[data-stack] tr {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 8px 12px;
    padding: 12px var(--g-pad);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  }
  .g-table[data-stack] tr:last-child {
    border-bottom: 0;
  }
  .g-table[data-stack] td {
    display: block;
    height: auto;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    text-align: left;
  }
  .g-table[data-stack] td:nth-child(2) {
    justify-self: end;
  }
  .g-table[data-stack] td[data-label]::before {
    content: attr(data-label);
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    color: var(--g-muted);
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .g-table[data-stack] td:nth-child(-n + 2)[data-label]::before {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* Status */
.g-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  height: 22px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 7%, transparent);
  color: var(--g-fg);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.g-badge[data-tone="success"] {
  background: var(--g-success-subtle);
  color: var(--g-success);
}
.g-badge[data-tone="warning"] {
  background: var(--g-warning-subtle);
  color: var(--g-warning);
}
.g-badge[data-tone="danger"] {
  background: var(--g-danger-subtle);
  color: var(--g-danger);
}
.g-badge[data-tone="info"] {
  background: var(--g-info-subtle);
  color: var(--g-info);
}
.g-alert {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: 4px 10px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--g-info-subtle);
  color: var(--g-info);
}
.g-alert[data-tone="success"] {
  background: var(--g-success-subtle);
  color: var(--g-success);
}
.g-alert[data-tone="warning"] {
  background: var(--g-warning-subtle);
  color: var(--g-warning);
}
.g-alert[data-tone="danger"] {
  background: var(--g-danger-subtle);
  color: var(--g-danger);
}
.g-alert strong {
  font-weight: 600;
}
.g-empty {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 48px var(--g-pad);
  text-align: center;
}
.g-empty p {
  max-width: 40ch;
  color: var(--g-muted);
}

/* Tabs, kbd, skeleton */
.g-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g-line);
}
.g-tab {
  height: var(--g-control);
  padding: 0 12px;
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  background: none;
  color: var(--g-muted);
  font: 500 var(--g-text) var(--g-font);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.g-tab[aria-selected="true"],
.g-tab[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-bottom-color: var(--g-fg);
  color: var(--g-fg);
}
.g-kbd {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  padding: 0 5px;
  border: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  border-bottom-width: 2px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: var(--g-card);
  color: var(--g-muted);
  font: 500 11px var(--g-mono);
}
.g-skeleton {
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 6%, transparent) 25%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 11%, transparent) 50%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--g-fg) 6%, transparent) 75%
  );
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: g-shimmer 1.4s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes g-shimmer {
  to {
    background-position: -200% 0;
  }
}

/* Overlays */
.g-dialog {
  width: min(480px, calc(100vw - 32px));
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--g-card);
  color: var(--g-fg);
  box-shadow: var(--g-shadow);
}
.g-dialog::backdrop {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}
.g-dialog-body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 20px;
}
.g-dialog-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--g-line);
}
.g-toast {
  position: fixed;
  right: 16px;
  bottom: 16px;
  z-index: 1500;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  max-width: min(420px, calc(100vw - 32px));
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--g-fg);
  color: var(--g-bg);
  box-shadow: var(--g-shadow);
  font-size: 14px;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .g-skeleton {
    animation: none;
  }
  .g-sidebar,
  .g-switch,
  .g-switch::after {
    transition: none;
  }
}
